description: Image Description: The image shows a street sign mounted on a metal pole. The sign has a rectangular shape and displays the name "VIA FERLINGHETTI" with the words "PRICE ROW" in smaller font beneath it. Above the street name, there is an arrow pointing left with the number "000" next to it. The background includes the side of a building with visible windows and some utility pipes running along the wall. A tree can be seen on the right side of the image
